candidates.statement: Order service returns 502 on /v1/orders because its payment dependency (/v1/authorizations) returns 503; gateway checkout 502s propagate from order. Payment unavailability is the bounded upstream fault.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/logs were not admitted; the 503 origin within payment (config, saturation, or crash) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 caused by order 502, which is caused by payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis reservations succeed. Gateway and order metrics corroborate 502s on /v1/checkout and /v1/orders. Payment-side evidence is missing, so the bounded candidate is payment unavailability propagating as 502, with payment root cause unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service metrics (request status, latency, dependency operations) to confirm the 503 source
Payment service logs/traces for the /v1/authorizations 503 error detail
Order service logs for the 502 error path and payment call handling
